title: test(studio): studioMenuPlacement's ADR_ROW skips ADR-0084's no-row entries (field, datasource), so deleting or regrouping them stays green
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

## Why this matters

ADR-0084's type-to-group table says every registered metadata type has a row, and `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` is the test that holds the Studio menu to that table. Two entries are written as no-row types, with no order and no tier: `field` (数据 Data) and, since #37920 (PR #37945, 7fbfd8f7), `datasource` (平台 Platform). The test reads neither. If someone deletes one of those rows, moves it to another group, or gives `datasource` a menu row again while the ADR still says it has none, the suite stays green. The maintainer's ruling that the Studio menu draws no datasource row then has no test behind it. This is review nit N3 on PR #37945, and that PR's seat record routes it to this follow-up.

## What is missing

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts:114`:

```
const ADR_ROW = /^\| \*\*[^|]+\*\* \| `([a-z_]+)` \| (\d+) \| `([a-z_]+)`[^|]* \| (常用|高级) \|$/;
```

`(\d+)` and `(常用|高级)` match only the ordered rows. The `| … | — | \`field\` | — |` and `| … | — | \`datasource\` | — |` rows (ADR-0084 lines 182 and 197 on main) are dropped by the filter, so `the ADR table is read: one row per listable type` counts only the listable types and never checks the no-row ones.

## Acceptance

- The test also reads ADR-0084's no-row entries (Order `—`, Tier `—`). It asserts that this set is exactly the registered types the Studio menu draws no row for (today `field` and `datasource`), and that each is in its served registry `domain`'s group.
- Ablations each turn the suite red: delete the `datasource` row; move it to another group; add `datasource` to `STUDIO_MENU_PLACEMENT`.
- The existing assertions on the ordered rows are kept as they are.

## Out of scope

N1 on PR #37945 (the table's legend explains only `field`'s dash) goes with #37740, which already owns ADR-0084's stale notes.
